tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa'i rnam thar bzhugs/na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ / e ma

ngo mtshar chos nyid theg dgu'i mkha' la thugs rje'i skal ldan pho mo la nyi 'od shar/ / rjes 'jug gi ma rig ling thog skye med mkha' la yal/ / kun la 'dzin med spros bral chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig mnyam nyid pa'i/ / re sa 'gro mgon drin can bla ma rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs/ 'khrul rjes 'jug gi don du me long rdo rjes zhus pa zhig bla ma'i lo rgyus zur tsam ni/ /yul la khyad 'phags g.yo ru grwa yi nang*/ / yab shangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa bzang po yin skad yab yum so ba 'brang du yum bkra shis dngos grub gnyis kyi sras/ / sku 'khrungs ngo mtshar rtags ldan nyi ma shar ba dang ri rtse la phyin pa dang 'ja' yis bskor ba kun rnams mos/ / skye ba sngon du chos kyi 'brel pas las 'phro sad pas 'dir bla ma bzang po'i dbon por 'khrungs / /lo dgu'i bla ma kun la dus su gsol 'debs mos gus srod tho rangs su bskyangs/ /lo bcu lon nas nges 'byung dad pa thun mong ma yin pa skyes/ /'jig rten tshe 'di 'i phyogs su gtong ri dbu snyung bzhes dag la blo ma zhugs/ / byas pa thams cad 'jig pa'i chos can mig cer re mi bden rdzun/ /sgyu ma lta bur sangs rgyas kyis mdo rgyud rnams su gsungs nas 'dug pa la/ / ma rtogs pa 'di rnams bden bden rtag rtag 'dra ba 'di lta bu/ / 'khor ba 'di la sems shing 'jigs pas shum shum zing zing sku lus kyi spu byas/ /bcu gnyis lon dus mi la gus pa'i bza' bca' la mtho 'grogs byas pa gzhan gyi spyod pa la/ /thugs mug skyo ba drag po yul mi skyes ba de rnams gting nas skyes/ / dus de na mtho 'grogs khyad gsod mi byed dam bca' mdzad pas mthar 'khyol / / bcu gsum lon tshe mtshan ltas mnal lam chu mig gtsang ma rdol ba dang nyi ma shar ba zla ba shar ba sogs ltas bzang po byung

lung bstan ni/ /thugs rje chen pos mdzad cing de'i dus su rdzogs chen gtad/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis byin brlabs thugs rje des/ /ngan zhing mi gang dbul zhing sprang po dang ngan long shig dang 'ji ba rnams la/ /snying rjes ma bzod dus rgyun du skyong ba'i dam bca' mdzad pa mthar yang 'khyol ba yin / /bco brgyad lon tshe 'khor 'das snang srid kyis bsdus snang ba thams cad bden med khong du chud snang ba la gzigs / /gtad med smyon pa'i spyod pas brang dang brla dang tshang ra la khyad med par rtogs pa'i sgo nas skabs su brang an re brdungs yang dus gcig gi tshe a ma na re khyod kyis gsol mchod gyis zer nas zan g.yag gtad pa rgyal po mchod bsen mo mchod byas pas khyod 'dra'i bu 'ong ba skye ba zer mi snang bzlog /sems kyis sems bltas dngos med stong par chos thams cad stong pa nyid du nges go /mtha' bzhi mu bral snying po'i don de khong du chud par byung / /dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga zer lon nas tshe 'di'i bya ba glos btang nas chos la bros/ /le 'u sgang pa'i mkhan po dang bkra shis sgang pa ba ste mkhan slob gnyis po yis/ / bdag gi mkhan slob mdzad de bstan thub pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba byas so / /dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bsrung bya dang bslab bya'i don bslab pa legs par lung nos/ /de nas drin can bla ma'i spyan sngar byon te seng ge rgyab tu bzhugs nas chos sgo phyes / /gting phyung dbang nas khrid zhang mtshal pa'i chos skor rnams rdzogs par zhus/ /yul de nas zhing brtsong nas 'khor gsum dag par byas/ /mkhan slob nyi zla zung gcig rtsa ri ba rje btsun ma dang*/ ka ri ka dang*/ beng rnams zhus/ seṅge mjing bsnol zhus / /ras pa dri ras chung pa'i a thung*/ zhi byed spyod skabs dang po dang 'bring po shog dril bzhi 'pho ba spyi rtol ma gser srang ma/ dang po'i sgrub pa dang po lugs

med lha ri dpal dang ni/ /sprul sku gzhon 'bum ston phyar byang gtum mo gsang sgrub yon dang*/ /mkhas btsun khyad 'phags slob dpon jo sras bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang*/ chos skyong rnams zhus / /myur zab gdams pa'i gnad zhus bla ma brgyad/ / chos bdag gu ru jo 'ber kyi thugs kyis bzung nas khyad 'phags gu ru gtsug gi rgyan gcig po/ /dbang rdzogs pa chen po snying tig yongs su rdzogs man ngag dpe rgyud rjes gnang bcas ma lus pa dang / / gsang de ltar gsang ba ba snying tig rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ste/ / tshul ji ltar gsungs na yid dpyod tshig la ma brten mngon sum du/ /mtha' bral nam mkha'i mthong nas 'od zer 'phro/ /zhi khro rang gsal bstan pa'i drin can lags/ /lar ni tshe 'di'i che dag spangs te dman sa rgyun du bzung*/ /sgrub pa mchog gi myur dus rgyun du blangs ri khrod dben sa brten zhang gi bzhugs gnas khro bo ma dang / /che 'brel tshe 'di la sangs rgya chung 'brel snying po'i thabs rdugs kyang sprul sku'i zhing don dang sprad/ / zhe 'dod med pa'i gnad 'gyod pa med do rjes bu slob rnams 'jug go ba long*/ / dus ngan sems can la skyo shas yi tshe 'di pa rnams mug lam khyer zhing khams blta/ / snang ba mi bstun thig le 'di la goms pa su byed nga dang gcig / ngus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rdzogs te sku gdung 'bar ba nas gsungs pa bzhin chos zad ka dag tu a ti'i ngang*/ /a ye ji bzhin pa kye ma 'khrul zhig drin can sangs rgyas dbon po kye/ dred po gnong ba'i gdung shugs 'o dod dus rgyun du 'bod/ / brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bla ma drin can 'khrul zhig rin po che/ mi lus snying po'i don can gong ma la ltos nas dong du lhung*/ / bla ma dang 'bral med thugs rje'i thag pa dus rgyun du thongs/ /theg chen sngags gsar rnying gnyis ka zhing la nyams len than pa byung*/

/ bla ma rnams la mos gus byas so byin brlabs chu rgyun phobs/ / le lo can snying med po yis nyams len zla ba phyi ma dang sang phod du phyi bshol byas/ /nyams mchog thun mong rtogs glo bur rkyen ci la yang brten nas gtad med du ston cig rtsa ba bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ /'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa'i rnam thar rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (4)'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa'i rnam thar/ -PAGE 140--PAGE 139--PAGE 137-
